content: Standard pattern: WireGuard site-to-site between Mikrotik CHR (public IP, AWS) and home router; RouterOS v7 has native WireGuard. Home side behind NAT initiates with persistent-keepalive=25. CHR dst-nats 80/443 across the tunnel to the downstream reverse proxy; firewall input chain must accept WG port and forward chain must accept inter-subnet traffic before drop rules. MTU 1420 start, 1380-1412 if PPPoE. src-nat/masquerade on CHR loses client IP; routing return traffic via tunnel preserves it. Sources: Mikrotik docs/forums, perlod, maksonlee.
